gale-sentinel.nota:
**Layer 1 of A3-E02: the perimeter.** “Two a.m. The Gale Sentinel lobby is empty except for a guard looking at his phone behind the desk. The wall screen is still on: a mosaic of thousands of live feeds, porches, hallways, rain.” The **video wall** takes up the north wall of the lobby, facing the main entrance; on the map it's off, and three “video wall” lights turn it on. Beneath it runs the motto “We see what the city doesn't.” (it isn't painted: no text on the map). The guard (one of the **two mortal guards**) sits in the chair behind the **reception desk**; the other is in the **security office** in the west wing, with the camera monitors.

**ANOMALY cameras (at every entrance)**, marked as `anomaly` objects with no light: ① above the main entrance, outside; ② in the southeast corner of the lobby, aimed at the door; ③ above the service exit to the yard, outside; ④ in the elevator hall, aimed at the turnstiles. Every Kindred who passes in front of one with the module active is logged as a “cold subject”: Thermometer +1 in total (A3-E02, layer 1). Disabling it from outside: Intelligence + Technology Diff. 4 (Ezra +2 dice if he already knows the firmware is his; LOR-03 at level 4: automatic). Obfuscate doesn't fool it.

**Entrances.** The main entrance (sliding glass door) opens onto the plaza and the parking lot: the “To the campus parking lot” region leads to the campus zone map (pending, t2i). The **service exit** off the north hallway opens onto the service yard, and from the yard you cross to the **data center** (region → `gale-datos`). The **turnstiles** (two card-access lanes, glass gates between railings) separate the lobby from the elevator hall; the service hallway also reaches the hall through a door with an electronic lock. Stairs and elevators go up to the **third floor** (`gale-planta3`).

**A1-E05 (physical access).** If the coterie uses Dominate on an on-call technician to get in, they come in this way and pass camera ① or ③: Thermometer +1 unless the cameras are disabled first.

**Running out** through the lobby and the plaza in front of the cameras: Thermometer +1. If the alarm goes off, Bellevue police take twelve minutes.

The ground-floor café and restrooms (hatched block to the southeast) are closed and aren't played.

gale-planta3.nota:
**Layer 2 of A3-E02: the offices.** “Third floor: Preston Gale's office. Office server room.” Every door leading off the landing, plus the doors to the office and the server room, has an **electronic lock**: Dexterity + Larceny Diff. 3, or Intelligence + Technology Diff. 3.

**The patrol.** Dawson and two security ghouls (MEN-04) come through every 40 minutes: they come up the stairs or the elevator, walk the north hallway, cross the open-plan floor, and return to the landing. Avoiding them: Wits + Stealth Diff. 3 for the whole group (Auspex, Heightened Senses: +2 dice; they can be heard coming from the landing). Hiding spots: behind the open-plan workstations, the kitchenette, the conference room (but it has glass partitions). Dawson smells Kindred within twenty meters: from the landing he reaches any point on the floor.

**Gale's office** (southwest corner, with a window wall overlooking the parking lot). On the **desk**, Gale's computer: Intelligence + Investigation Diff. 3. One success: **Preston Gale's digital signature on the Market Street access authorizations (P-11)**. Three or more: also **the “C.H.” email**: “Recover all copies. Top priority. — C.H.”, dated November 13. The payment records to Lonnie from Cascade Holdings (P-14) are also there, if they don't already have them. If Celeste came as a shareholder and Gale receives her, it's here: the chair behind the desk, the sofa facing the door.

**Office server room** (northwest). The rack at the back is the **poorly secured test server** from A1-E05 (if the coterie goes in person instead of remotely): Intelligence + Technology Diff. 4 to get in; Intelligence + Investigation Diff. 3 for the November 9 order authorized by “P.G.” (P-06); DOC-11 is in the “Q1_board_deck_DRAFT” folder (automatic). If they fail, Gale logs the attempt (Thermometer +1 the following night).

**North window wall.** From the hallway you can see the service yard and the windowless hulk of the data center, humming.

Stairs and elevators go down to the lobby (`gale-sentinel`). Chairs in the open-plan floor and the conference room: optional tiles, not listed one by one.

gale-datos.nota:
**Layer 3 of A3-E02: the data center.** “A windowless building behind the main one. Three rooms: storage, ANOMALY training, private archive.” “A door with biometrics (fingerprint and retina) and a security mantrap. One ghoul in the control room.”

**The infiltration strip.** The service road (west) comes from the parking lot (“To the campus parking lot” region, pending: zone map) and the service yard (south) comes from the office building (region → `gale-sentinel`). The generator and chillers in the yard give cover for approaching the mantrap. Running out across the campus in front of the cameras: Thermometer +1.

**The three security levels** (the text doesn't detail them; they break down like this):
1. **The mantrap.** Outer door with a card reader; inner door **locked** with a biometric reader (Gale's or Dawson's fingerprint and retina). The two doors don't open at the same time. Forcing it: Strength + Athletics Diff. 5, and the alarm goes off. With Gale in hand (Celeste, Manipulation + Persuasion Diff. 4, or Dominate: Gale has Composure 2; Dawson, Resolve 3 and +2 dice from the Bond) the inner door opens without a roll. The ghoul in the **control room** watches the mantrap through the armored window.
2. **The rooms** (storage and testing): **locked** card-access doors; they open from the control room console or with the ghoul's card. From the hallway you can see inside through the glass windows: on the left, “rows of black cabinets hum under blue lights”; on the right, the wall of faces.
3. **The private archive**, at the end of the hallway: a **locked** door with its own lock, no network, isolated from everything else.

**ANOMALY cameras (at the entrances)**, `anomaly` objects with no light: ① above the outer mantrap door; ② inside the mantrap; ③ in the southwest corner, covering the yard and the service road; ④ and ⑤ above the two emergency exits, outside. If the coterie didn't disable the module in layer 1, every Kindred who enters is logged (the Thermometer +1 counts only once for the whole incursion).

**What's in each room:**
- **Storage** (west): four rows of racks. In the **fireproof media safe** (southwest corner), the **original drive of the File, only until Night 6**. On the **management console**, the shipping logs for the ARCHER channel with the reference **SEA-0411 (P-10)** and the complete **DOC-07**.
- **Testing room · ANOMALY training** (east): “On one wall there's a screen with a grid of faces, hundreds of them, each with a label underneath: COLD_SUBJECT, and a number. Some of them you know from Elysium. One of them is yours.” This is the **wall of faces** (east wall; off on the map, two “video wall” lights turn it on). At the workstations, the **cold subject database** (it includes the coterie if the 3B camera recorded them in A0-E01) and **DOC-11**, if they don't have it. To the north, open to the room, the compute room with the GPU racks.
- **Private archive** (north, at the end of the hallway): the **air-gapped server** with Halloway's personal archive, scanned by Pell. Copying it: Intelligence + Technology Diff. 3. The folios on “the German” (**P-15**): Intelligence + Investigation Diff. 4, or automatic by searching for “allemand.” This server is the one that may end up in the briefcase in A4-E03.

**Alarm.** If it goes off (mantrap forced, emergency exit opened), Dawson takes **four minutes** to arrive from the office building, and Bellevue police take **twelve**. The emergency exits (west and east) only open from inside and trip the alarm: they're the escape route for an assault.

**Assault** (Combat): Thermometer +2; Gale warns Halloway, who moves the original that same night if they don't take it. Dawson, alive and captured, is a witness.

The hatched blocks (UPS and battery utility rooms to the southwest, cooling to the southeast) aren't played.
